rows.title: Fees named by kind
rows.defect: the overdraft pattern forgets "item", so OVERDRAFT ITEM FEE is no fee at all
rows.test: OVERDRAFT ITEM FEE is an overdraft fee

rows.title: ATM cash is not a fee
rows.defect: any ATM line counts, fee word or not
rows.test: a $200 ATM withdrawal is no candidate

rows.title: A business named maintenance is not the bank
rows.defect: bare "maintenance" or "monthly service" is a fee (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: VALLEY AUTO MAINTENANCE is no fee

rows.title: A fee's reversal is not a fee
rows.defect: reversal wording is not excluded first
rows.test: OVERDRAFT FEE REVERSAL is no fee

rows.title: The fee request, word for word
rows.defect: cents are not zero-padded, so $35.05 is written $35.5
rows.test: $35.05 is written $35.05

rows.title: The person sends it
rows.defect: the draft no longer needs the person's approval
rows.test: the draft needs the person's approval

rows.title: Day 60 is in the window
rows.defect: the window's last day is left out
rows.test: a reversal on day 60 is a lead

rows.title: A reversal named twice is still a lead
rows.defect: only the first reversal word is removed before naming the fee (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: OD FEE REVERSAL CREDIT links to the fee

rows.title: One reversal, one fee
rows.defect: a used credit is not taken out of the index
rows.test: the second fee has no lead

rows.title: A bigger credit is not the refund
rows.defect: the amount cap is dropped
rows.test: a $9.99 credit is not a $3.00 fee's refund

rows.title: Three days apart is still a possible duplicate
rows.defect: the window is read as under 3 days
rows.test: Oct 2 and Oct 5 are a pair

rows.title: One charge's amount back
rows.defect: both charges are added up
rows.test: a $49.99 double charge asks for $49.99

rows.title: Three charges, one pair
rows.defect: the paired charge is not skipped, so the middle one pairs twice
rows.test: three $5.00 charges are one candidate

rows.title: Transfers are not duplicates
rows.defect: transfers are grouped for duplicates
rows.test: two $500 transfers are no candidate

rows.title: A fee is a fee once
rows.defect: fees already claimed are grouped for duplicates too
rows.test: two ATM fees are two fees, no duplicate

rows.title: Seven days pending is stale
rows.defect: a hold must be over 7 days
rows.test: a hold from Oct 5 is a lead on Oct 12

rows.title: Other currencies are left out
rows.defect: the currency check is dropped
rows.test: a EUR overdraft fee is counted, not drafted in dollars

rows.title: Tomorrow's row is left out, not fatal
rows.defect: a row dated after today throws (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: a charge dated Oct 13 does not stop the Oct 12 scan

rows.title: This evening's rows are today's
rows.defect: rows dated the day after (bank dates are UTC) are dropped, so the draft asks for money already given back
rows.test: an Oct 13 reversal links to its fee in the Oct 12 scan

rows.title: Conflicting copies stop the scan
rows.defect: a repeated id is skipped without comparing its facts
rows.test: the same id with $3.50 and $35.00 throws

rows.title: Biggest first
rows.defect: the order is reversed
rows.test: the $200 hold before the $35 fee

rows.title: $500.00 is still a fee
rows.defect: the cap excludes exactly $500.00
rows.test: a $500.00 overdraft fee is a candidate
